acceptanceCriteria: An operator-run qualification verb checks a supplied json-reporter document against the existing fixture checks and records the version in a store-local allow-list with retained evidence; failures refuse with a stable code.
A ticket or policy can declare a local test repository; witness commit resolution and the TOL-V0-012 spec check run there.
A Playwright 1.64 json report from a separate test repository credits a row whose test passed at retry 0.
Refusal codes are unchanged for unqualified versions and undeclared repositories.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1070 (2026-10-17). (1) The qualified Playwright version allow-list is empty, so every real json-reporter document is refused UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (TOL-V0-009); an adopter on 1.64 has no qualification path. (2) The witness commit and the spec containing the obligation id (TOL-V0-012) must resolve in the task-store repository, so a layout with tests in a separate repository cannot witness. Proposal: an operator verb that runs the existing fixture checks on a supplied retained report and appends the version to a store-local allow-list with evidence (or minor/patch qualification by passing fixture); a ticket- or policy-declared test repository where TOL-V0-012 is checked.
title: ticket obligations witness: adopter qualification path for newer Playwright versions and witness commits resolved in a declared test repository (issue #1070)
